title: Demo: read a dispatch note into JSON
summary: Read a short courier dispatch note and return its fields as JSON. Demo-only task for the local chain.
instructions:
Read the dispatch note below and return it as a JSON object with the fields note_number (a whole number), recipient (the person's full name), city (the city of the delivery address, without the street or the postcode), parcels (the number of parcels, a whole number), weight_kg (the gross weight in kilograms, a number), express (true if the service is express delivery, else false) and signature_required (true if a signature is required, else false).

Reply with the JSON object only: no code fences, no explanation before or after it.

How it is checked: your JSON must fit the published schema. Then each value in it is compared with a hidden answer key. The score is the share of values that match, and the reward is paid only for a score of 100.

Demo-only: this task is part of the tracked demo set, with its answers in the open, and runs on a local chain only.

-----BEGIN DATA-----
Dispatch note 4082
Recipient: Kunle Adebayo
Ship to: 9 Harbour Lane, Port Harcourt
Parcels: 5 (3 boxes, 1 tube and 1 envelope)
Gross weight: 18.25 kg
Service: express delivery, no signature needed
-----END DATA-----
